verdicts.reason: Both candidates simply drop the original banner into the middle of the portrait canvas without rearranging it. That leaves huge dead white areas above and below, a thin cropped building strip, and the headline hanging below the strip with its first line touching the image, so nothing is laid out for the new format. A and B are almost the same: B has slightly more right margin (about 39px against A's 28px), but neither fixes the empty, unbalanced composition.
